description: Static stand-in for Storage's SP-1101 sealed write custody of DS15 originals (sweep part 2B, S-N2; batch 2 fix 1). stores: the families each Storage instance's custody holds (a Store never supplies a recipe); resource_manifests: the SHA-256 manifest of the frozen resources each family's originals were written against; sealed_originals: the binding (Storage instance, scope, Server, Project, event type, ids, owner operation, CV-339 commitment) and write recipe of the one receipt sealed with each original at its ref (more than one only for the deliberate SX09 negatives); a retained read selects only from that receipt. Recorded once by scripts/pm_ds15_p2b_cases.py --write-custody; the case under check never adds to it. Native custody NOT_RUN.
